question: Will AMD beat earnings expectations for Q2 2026?

model.prompt_context: Resolves YES if Advanced Micro Devices (AMD) reports non-GAAP diluted EPS strictly greater than the Wall Street consensus estimate (as published by Zacks Investment Research immediately prior to the earnings release) for Q2 2026 in its earnings release. Resolves NO if non-GAAP diluted EPS is at or below that consensus figure. Canonical source: AMD's official Q2 2026 earnings press release (ir.amd.com).
